wantedsort-summary: Introductory paragraph shown beneath the page heading via outputHeader().
wantedsort-field-namespace: Label for the namespace filter dropdown.
wantedsort-submit: Text on the form submit button.
wantedsort-ns-all: Option in the namespace dropdown meaning 'no namespace filter'.
wantedsort-sort-links: Option label: sort by number of incoming links.
wantedsort-sort-title: Option label: sort alphabetically by page title.
wantedsort-col-title: Table column header: the wanted page title.
wantedsort-col-namespace: Table column header: the namespace of the wanted page.
wantedsort-col-links: Table column header: number of pages linking to the wanted page.
wantedsort-col-wlh: Table column header: link to Special:WhatLinksHere for the wanted page.
wantedsort-showing-from: Pagination status without a total (total is not computed to avoid full scans). $1 = first result number on this page, $2 = last result number on this page.
wantedsort-noresults: Message shown when no wanted pages match the active filters.
wantedsort-miser-notice: Shown when $wgMiserMode is enabled. Explains capped limits and caching.
wantedsort-cached-notice: Shown when the current result page was loaded from WANObjectCache rather than a live SQL query.
wantedsort-export-csv: Link text for downloading the filtered wanted-pages list as a CSV file.
wantedsort-export-note: Shown next to the export link. $1 = maximum number of rows included in the download.
wantedsort-export-truncated: Appended as a # comment line at the end of a CSV export when the result set was larger than the export cap. $1 = the cap.
wantedsort-export-loginrequired: Shown to anonymous users instead of the export link, and as the reason on the login page when they hit ?export=csv directly. Includes a wikilink to Special:UserLogin.
